text:
For most people, the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is the best pick. These are the standouts from the reviews I found.

**Top picks**

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** It lists at $109 but was $98 at WIRED's link, $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. It charges an iPhone at 15W and fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer. The phone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode, and the 36W power supply is included. It has a 2-year warranty. WIRED named it best overall. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max, $169.** It does Qi2 25W for the iPhone and has a heavy base that lets you lift the phone off one-handed. No power adapter is included, so you need a 40W one (Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter is $25). ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station.** It was about $40 on sale (normally $80) at WIRED's Amazon link. It charges at 15W, and the power brick and cable are included. The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))
- **Best flat pad design: Nimble Podium 3-in-1, $130.** It supports Qi2 25W and lets your devices lie flat. Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. ([WIRED](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/))

**Foldable travel options**

- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2), about $80 on sale.** It's compact and charges at 15W. ([WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/))
- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W, $129.99.** It's the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand Macworld has tested, and it works well as a desk stand. A 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs are included. ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **ESR CryoBoost 25W, about $100.** It has a cooling fan with an off button. ESR's store lists it at $99.99, and Dealectric says the code PARTNER18 takes it to about $82, tested on Oct 23. That is an affiliate link, and checkout has the final word on price. ([Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand))

**Things to check before buying**

- **25W only helps newer phones.** WIRED notes Qi2 25W isn't widely supported and makes little difference for overnight charging. Per ESR, the full 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. Other recent models get about 20W and older ones 15W. If you charge overnight, a 15W model like the Belkin is plenty.
- **AirPods case.** It must support wireless charging, which the AirPods Pro and the AirPods with a wireless charging case do.
- **Prices change.** The sale prices above came from the articles and may have moved.

I can't browse retailer pages here, so the WIRED guide is the best place to find current buy links for the Belkin, Nomad, ESR and Nimble models.
